title: Intelligence Brief
subtitle: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell Music su, Three of today's top four GitHub-trending repos ar, p-e-w/heretic automates 'directional ablation' --

insights.text: Sony Music Publishing and Warner Chappell Music sued Anthropic, alleging a 'brazen campaign' of torrenting, scraping, and lyric-repository theft that infringed 'tens of thousands' of copyrighted compositions -- a wider scope than prior label suits. The complaint names co-founders Dario Amodei and Benjamin Mann personally and seeks up to $150,000 per infringed work plus $25,000 per instance of removed copyright management information.

Three of today's top four GitHub-trending repos are single-purpose agent skills rather than models or general frameworks: tt-a1i/archify (diagram generation, +3,722 stars today, 35.6K total -- the same skill available in this vault's own Claude Code environment), K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills (163 research skills, 39.7K total, claims 190,000+ scientist users), and THU-MAIC/OpenMAIC (multi-agent classroom, 24.7K total). A distinct axis from the marketplace-collection cooldown this vault has tracked all week.

p-e-w/heretic automates 'directional ablation' -- removing a model's safety-refusal behavior without retraining, via automatic parameter search -- and claims over 5,000 Heretic-processed models already published to Hugging Face. Today's Hugging Face trending board shows the result: five separately-branded uncensored/obliterated forks of one flagship release, Qwen3.8-27B, in the top 20, days after its own release.

The EU Commission's supervision and enforcement powers against general-purpose AI model providers activated 2026-08-02, and the AI Office has begun sending Requests for Information to verify compliance -- the first move from statutory power to practice this vault has tracked. Fines can reach €15 million or 3% of a provider's global annual turnover.
insights.source: Help Net Security / EU AI Act enforcement coverage (deep-read)

insights.text: 2026's ASO playbook adds AI-generated/natural-language discovery alongside keyword optimization, and Apple's Custom Product Page limit doubled from 35 to 70. Layered onto this, Google's incoming Play memory-footprint rule (8GB-device apps capped at 2.25GB from February 2027) ties reduced app visibility to non-compliance -- making resource-budget discipline an ASO lever for indie developers, not just a technical concern.

Product Hunt's board carries three same-day agent-infrastructure launches: Superagent ('Claude Code for the rest of us'), Maritime ('dedicated computers for AI agents, starting at $1/month'), and oMLX ('Mac LLM server that cuts agent wait times from 90s to 5s').

'Haiku R1/beta6 has been released,' today's HN #9 (277 pts/84 comments), is the Haiku operating system -- the BeOS-inspired hobbyist OS -- not an Anthropic model, despite the name collision. The release closes ~530 tickets, nearly halves compile time, and adds Firefox/Go support, landing one week after the project's 25th anniversary.
Omarchy: Any User Process Can Escalate to Root topped both Hacker News (473 pts/451 comments) and Lobsters today -- the highest-comment-count security story on the board, not yet deep-read.

takeaway.text: Sony Music and Warner Chappell sue Anthropic over a broader copyright claim than any prior label suit; three of today's top GitHub-trending repos are single-purpose agent skills rather than models or frameworks; an automated abliteration tool and five 'uncensored' Qwen3.8-27B forks show model-uncensoring has become a commodity, same-week pipeline; the EU AI Act's enforcement powers move from statute to practice with the first RFIs to GPAI providers; and Google's incoming Play memory-footprint rule turns technical resource discipline into an ASO discoverability risk for indie developers.
